title: dect_nr: Fix PCC-only feedback parsing
description:
Wireshark marks Feedback (which is PCC-only) as Malformed.
This fix marks the packet as a Feedback in the Info column and also provides additional details regarding the process HARQ number, the retrieval, BS, and CQI.

AI-Assisted: no
